chunks: And al-Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Ḥumayd ibn Ziyād, from al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad ibn Samāʿah, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, who said:
I asked al-ʿAbd al-Ṣāliḥ عليه السلام about a woman who dies while her child is in her belly. He said: “Her belly is to be cut open and her child brought out.”

key_terms.الْعَبْدَ الصَّالِحَ: A title used for the Imam عليه السلام in this narration.
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: The woman being asked about in the legal case.
key_terms.تَمُوتُ: Dies; referring to the woman’s death.
key_terms.يُخْرَجُ: Is to be brought out or extracted.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pregnant woman dies while her child is still in her womb?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased pregnant woman whose child remains in her womb. It states that her abdomen should be opened so that the child may be taken out, reflecting a jurisprudential ruling related to death and the treatment of the deceased.
